target.title: fix(http-body): keep emoji / surrogate pairs intact during error body truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`snippetErrorBody` truncates HTTP error body text with `.slice()` which counts UTF-16 code units. When a surrogate-pair character straddles the cut boundary, `.slice()` produces a lone surrogate rendering as `�`.

Same pattern as the already-merged PR #101517.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace `.slice(0, maxChars)` with `Array.from(collapsed).slice(0, maxChars).join("")` so truncation counts full code points.

## User Impact

No `�` in diagnostic/error body snippets when content contains emoji near the truncation boundary.

## Evidence

```
BEFORE: "aaaaa\ud83d…"  lone: true
AFTER:  "aaaaaa📊…"     lone: false
```

## Regression Test Plan

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/http-body.test.ts --run
  Test Files  1 passed (1) / Tests  13 passed (13)

oxfmt --check — passed / oxlint — clean
```

AI-assisted.
